text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Even though I prepared so thoroughly for 
today... Even though I worked so hard in 
training...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... Even after you helped me so 
much, Trainer... I...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I guess it really is difficult for someone 
as ordinary as me to win after all...
choice_data_list: What matters is never giving up
Then are you giving up already?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I knew from the very beginning that dreams 
don't come true easily...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for sounding so timid. I'm okay 
now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I might do nothing but lose, but I'll do 
my best so I can win next time, so please 
keep supporting me...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I don't want to! I don't want to 
give up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I have a goal I'm striving for! No matter 
how miserable it gets, I don't want to 
give up on running!"
choice_data_list:
A resolve that strong is anything but 
ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I will work harder than ever before. I'll 
also put more thought into my training 
routine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So please, continue to look after me...!
